CLACKBLADE

CLACKBLADE is a dark fantasy typing-action game. Finish words to strike, press Space to parry, and break enemy stamina to unleash Slayer.

Play CLACKBLADE →
Free in your desktop browser. Keyboard required.

Enter the duel

Learn the rhythm in the interactive tutorial, then test your typing and timing against skeletal opponents.

Follow development

Follow CLACKBLADE on itch.io for development updates. Found a bug or have feedback? Leave a comment on the game page.
